clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
clauses.question: Have the external and internal issues relevant to the ISMS been determined, and are they kept up to date? (e.g. ISMS scope document, context analysis)

clauses.title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
clauses.question: Are the interested parties, their relevant requirements, and which of them are addressed through the ISMS determined? (e.g. register of requirements)

clauses.title: Scope of the ISMS
clauses.question: Is the ISMS scope documented, including boundaries, interfaces and dependencies with activities performed by other organizations?

clauses.title: Information security management system
clauses.question: Are the ISMS processes and their interactions established, implemented, maintained and continually improved?

clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
clauses.question: Does top management demonstrate leadership: policy and objectives aligned with strategy, resources available, importance of information security communicated?

clauses.title: Information security policy
clauses.question: Is the information security policy documented, approved, communicated within the organization and available to interested parties?

clauses.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
clauses.question: Are responsibilities and authorities for information security roles assigned and communicated, including reporting on ISMS performance to top management?

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
clauses.question: Have the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed been determined, and are actions planned and evaluated for effectiveness?

clauses.title: Information security risk assessment
clauses.question: Is a risk assessment process defined (acceptance criteria, criteria for performing assessments) that produces consistent, valid and comparable results, with risk owners identified?

clauses.title: Information security risk treatment
clauses.question: Are treatment options selected, controls compared with Annex A, a Statement of Applicability produced with justifications, a risk treatment plan formulated, and residual risks accepted by risk owners?

clauses.title: Information security objectives and planning
clauses.question: Are measurable objectives established, monitored and communicated, with what will be done, resources, responsibilities, deadlines and how results are evaluated?

clauses.title: Planning of changes
clauses.question: When changes to the ISMS are needed, are they carried out in a planned manner?

clauses.title: Resources
clauses.question: Are the resources needed for the ISMS determined and provided?

clauses.title: Competence
clauses.question: Is the necessary competence determined and ensured through education, training or experience, the effectiveness of actions evaluated, and evidence retained?

clauses.title: Awareness
clauses.question: Are people aware of the information security policy, their contribution to the ISMS, and the implications of not conforming?

clauses.title: Communication
clauses.question: Is it determined what, when, with whom and how to communicate about the ISMS?

clauses.title: Documented information
clauses.question: Is the documented information required by the standard and the ISMS created, updated (identification, format, review, approval) and controlled (distribution, access, storage, retention)?

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.question: Are the processes needed to meet the requirements planned, implemented and controlled, including outsourced processes and planned changes?

clauses.title: Information security risk assessment (operation)
clauses.question: Are risk assessments performed at planned intervals and when significant changes occur, and are their results retained?

clauses.title: Information security risk treatment (operation)
clauses.question: Is the risk treatment plan implemented, and are the results of risk treatment retained?

clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
clauses.question: Is it determined what is monitored and measured, by which methods, when, by whom, and are the results analysed, evaluated and retained?

clauses.title: Internal audit
clauses.question: Is an audit programme (frequency, methods, responsibilities, reporting) established, and are audits conducted by objective and impartial auditors, with results reported to management?

clauses.title: Management review
clauses.question: Does top management review the ISMS at planned intervals, considering all the required inputs, and are the decisions retained?

clauses.title: Continual improvement
clauses.question: Is the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the ISMS continually improved?

clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.question: Are nonconformities reacted to, their causes analysed, corrective actions implemented and their effectiveness reviewed, with evidence retained?
